title: Contextual Distributionally Robust Optimization with Causal and Continuous Structure
abstract: arXiv:2601.11016v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: WWe propose a framework for contextual distributionally robust optimization (DRO) that considers the causal and continuous structure of the underlying distribution, and we develop interpretable and tractable decision rules. We first introduce the causal Sinkhorn discrepancy (CSD), an entropy-regularized causal Wasserstein distance that encourages continuous transport plans while preserving causal consistency. We then formulate a contextual DRO model with a CSD-based ambiguity set, termed Causal Sinkhorn DRO (Causal-SDRO), and derive its strong dual reformulation, where the worst-case distribution is characterized as a mixture of Gibbs distributions. To obtain an (infinite-dimensional) optimal policy, we propose a soft regression forest (SRF) decision rule: it preserves the interpretability of classical decision trees while being fully parametric, differentiable, and Lipschitz-smooth, enabling intrinsic interpretation from both

translated_title: 具有因果与连续结构的情境化分布鲁棒优化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个考虑底层分布的因果结构与连续结构的情境化分布鲁棒优化（DRO）框架，并开发了可解释且易处理的决策规则。我们首先引入因果 Sinkhorn 散度（CSD），这是一种熵正则化的因果 Wasserstein 距离，在保持因果一致性的同时鼓励连续的传输计划。随后，我们基于 CSD 构建了模糊集，建立了情境化 DRO 模型，称为因果 Sinkhorn DRO（Causal-SDRO），并推导出其强对偶重构形式，其中最坏情况分布被刻画为 Gibbs 分布的混合。为了获得（无限维的）最优策略，我们提出了软回归森林（SRF）决策规则：它既保留了经典决策树的可解释性，又是完全参数化、可微且 Lipschitz 光滑的，从而能够实现内在的解释性。
tldr: 该论文提出了融合因果与连续结构的情境化分布鲁棒优化框架，通过引入因果 Sinkhorn 散度构建模糊集并给出强对偶形式，同时设计了可微、光滑且可解释的软回归森林决策规则来求解最优策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a contextual DRO framework incorporating causal and continuous structure, introducing the causal Sinkhorn discrepancy to construct the ambiguity set with a strong dual reformulation, and designing a differentiable, Lipschitz-smooth, and interpretable soft regression forest decision rule to obtain optimal policies.
